## 2. LTC to any place in lndia.-  
- (a) This concession is admissible in lieu of one of the two concessions to home town in a block of four years.
- (b) The present block is 2022-2025.
- (c) Officials availing LTC to home town for self alone every year are not entitled to LTC to any place in India. - Rule 8.
